* V10 reputation, appointment, school and rivalry events: event prose
  and detailed branching by ChatGPT. Requested social outcomes and
  leadership roles, including ostracism, laughingstock, village idiot,
  mad scientist, trusted advisor, teacher and heads of professions:
  Lorsieab2. VV3–VV5-only Magic/Nature faction rule: Lorsieab2.

ledger.why: designer note: VV3-VV5 only; the VV3 Chief is never displaced

items.text: restore a neglected garden
decorate a ceremonial gathering place
explain an unusual weather pattern
teach children about the island
protect a fragile grove
design a beautiful public monument
Both proposals have strengths and weaknesses.
The Magician gives a magnificent speech but forgets to explain the practical steps.
The Naturalist brings seventeen charts and no one can read the tiny labels.
The two work together grudgingly and achieve an unexpectedly lovely result.
They spend an hour arguing about whose name should appear first on the plaque.
They agree to divide tasks by expertise.
The elder reminds them that disagreement is not a reason to insult one another.
The elder is secretly enjoying the argument and has to be reminded to mediate.
The elder admits both traditions matter to different people for different reasons.
The apprentices identify a practical combination.
Neither proposal works as expected; both experts must revise their assumptions.
A child asks whether the argument itself is part of the ceremony. Nobody answers.
They reconcile and become occasional collaborators.
They still hate each other, but now respect each other's competence.
One publicly admits (one.he/she) was wrong. The other nearly faints.
Their feud becomes a running village joke, until the leaders ask the audience to stop encouraging the shouting.
The Magician is recognized as head magician after a long record of service, while the Naturalist becomes head naturalist.
Neither receives a title. Both are told to spend a week learning how to listen.
One says, "I will never agree with you." The other replies, "Good. I'd worry if you did."

intro.name: Two traditions
intro.text: A respected Magician and a respected Naturalist have been arguing for weeks over the best way to {A}.

question.name: Unbearably smug
question.text:
The Magician insists on {ritual|symbolism|creative intuition|traditional magical practice}. The Naturalist argues for {observation|soil testing|ecological balance|careful natural methods}.
Neither is necessarily foolish. Both are unbearably smug.
